meta.subtitle: Calculate mean, median, mode, and range of numbers

editor.placeholder_numbers: Enter numbers separated by commas, spaces, or new lines

content.what_text: An average is a single value that represents the central tendency of a data set. There are three main types: Mean (arithmetic average), Median (middle value), and Mode (most frequent value).

types.name: Mean
types.desc: Sum of all values divided by the count. Most commonly used average.

types.name: Median
types.desc: Middle value when data is sorted. Better for skewed data.

types.name: Mode
types.desc: Most frequently occurring value. Useful for categorical data.

types.name: Range
types.desc: Difference between max and min values. Measures data spread.

js.error_empty: Please enter at least one number
